summary: Documentation map for Hoplight, the Vaudeville Studios desktop app for AI-roleplay content including characters, lorebooks, personas, presets, and regex sets. The engine and CLI are vaud; the UI is a Bun and React app. Docs split by audience: guide teaches app users one task per page; reference documents the engine and UI for builders; decisions and founding planning docs sit alongside both. The Guide section indexes getting-started, importing, converting, editing, exporting, lorebooks, and per-platform pages under guide/platforms for Agnai, Backyard, Chub, Lumiverse, Marinara, NovelAI, Pygmalion, RisuAI, RoleCall, and SillyTavern. The Reference section indexes the reference contract, architecture, entity schemas, format families, cross-cutting concepts, UI, components catalog, and platform-native fields; Chub has a guide page but no dedicated reference page yet. Decisions and planning covers nine ADRs ADR-001 through ADR-009, founding docs 01-VISION, 02-ARCHITECTURE, and 03-CONVENTIONS, ROADMAP milestones, FORMAT-SUPPORT generated from the live matrix, and notes that docs/generated, figures, and media are embeds not browse pages. As-built architecture lives in reference/architecture.md; 02-ARCHITECTURE describes the future vaudeville-studios layout.

sections.title: Guide
sections.summary: User-facing task pages under docs/guide. getting-started covers install, first-run wizard, Dock, and first file. importing brings a file into the Library and explains the import receipt. converting moves a card between platform formats. editing opens a piece on the Workbench, edits, and saves the draft. exporting sends a piece out through the character editor or a staged batch. lorebooks covers entries, keywords, triggers, and position. guide/platforms has one page per source platform: Agnai, Backyard, Chub, Lumiverse, Marinara, NovelAI, Pygmalion, RisuAI, RoleCall, SillyTavern.

sections.title: Reference
sections.summary: Builder-facing reference tree. reference/README is the tree contract and how to read a field table. architecture covers canonical model, escrow, adapter contract, entity kinds, registry, and CLI. entities/*.md hold canonical schemas for character, lorebook, pack, persona, preset, and regex. formats/README is the coverage matrix plus one page per format family. concepts cover character_book, persona editor, regex editor, regex engine, safe rendering, and tag taxonomy. ui.md documents vaud ui, local server, and React shell. components.md is the auto-generated UI catalog. platform-native-fields.md holds verified native-field research. Chub has a guide page but no dedicated reference page; its format lives in the coverage matrix and source folder.

sections.title: Decisions and planning
sections.summary: docs/decisions holds nine ADRs from ADR-001 through ADR-009; read them in order, later ones supersede earlier ones where their heading says so. 01-VISION, 02-ARCHITECTURE, and 03-CONVENTIONS are founding planning docs for audience, planned repo layout, and binding conventions. 02-ARCHITECTURE's layout is the future vaudeville-studios code repo; as-built architecture is reference/architecture.md. ROADMAP carries current milestones and exit criteria. FORMAT-SUPPORT is the per-field format matrix generated from the live adapter registry via bun run matrix. docs/generated, figures, and media hold field tables, diagram data, and screenshots for embeds and are not pages to browse alone.
